question: My soccer team has 16 players.  I have to choose a starting lineup of a goalie and 10 regular players (the regular players are interchangeable).  How many different starting lineups can I choose?
solution:
Choose the goalie in 16 ways. Of the remaining 15 players, choose the 5 who sit out; this determines the 10 interchangeable regular players without counting their order. There are C(15,5) = (15·14·13·12·11)/(5·4·3·2·1) = 3003 choices for those five. Multiplying gives 16·3003 = 48,048 lineups.
Final answer: 48,\!048
